items.requirement: Create verified developer accounts and reserve PacedMind app identities; if using EAS cloud builds, set the mobile build owner and EAS project ID.

Deploy and validate the authorization-code-only PKCE handoff and redirect allowlist on real devices: Google/email success, cancellation, recovery, expired/replayed links and killed-app returns. Verify cookie persistence; add verified app/universal links when store identities are reserved.

Verify companion-only billing eligibility for each target storefront, audit every native screen for purchase calls to action, and complete a supported cancellation/deletion flow for subscribed accounts. Otherwise implement StoreKit/Play Billing and server-verified entitlements.

Deliver and validate useful native functionality beyond a website shell (for example native notifications with task actions and a widget). The present WebView scaffold is not sufficient evidence for App Review 4.2.

Complete App Privacy/Data safety and SDK/required-reason API audits from actual release binaries. Deploy and verify pacedmind.com/delete-account and in-app account deletion for accounts with and without 2FA and subscriptions.

Build signed iOS archive/Android AAB; test real devices, tablet sizes, keyboard, accessibility, back navigation, logout/revocation, account deletion, offline/retry and links. Supply native screenshots and review credentials.
Enroll Play App Signing, complete content/ads/audience declarations, confirm current target SDK and 16 KB page compatibility, and complete closed testing when the account requires it.
Supply a trusted code-signing identity and Windows SDK signtool, build release --store, inspect signed installer/uninstaller, and host the immutable installer URL entered in Partner Center.

Verify silent install/uninstall, upgrade from the existing NSIS installation, data preservation, shortcuts, agent launching and notifications on clean Windows systems. Complete listing, ratings, privacy and support links.

On a Mac provide the Developer ID and notarization profile, build the universal DMG and test Gatekeeper, install/upgrade, keychain, agent terminals, notifications and data preservation on Apple silicon and Intel.

Design and build a separate sandboxed Mac companion or demonstrate an approved sandbox-compatible launcher. The existing unsandboxed Electron app that starts arbitrary external CLI tools is not a Mac App Store package.
